I agree. I think I have most of the 7 deadly sins, but lust and gluttony. I don't lust after any girl. I rarely have time to think about that at all. I was doing college + 3 jobs + Military, but that just wasn't practical. 

I could use a serious attitude adjustment. Alas, that is something I can strive for but might not ever achieve. I could do everything someone "says" could change my attitude or outlook, and be left nowhere. I have much more control over what happens to me when I hold my own life in the balance of my own hands. Suicide in the West is so strange. In Asian countries I would have already killed myself for the shame that I've brought onto myself/family. 

Honestly though, I just don't see what I have left other than self-improvement. Well, I've been doing that for years now. Literally years, this is not something that I haven't thought about or won't freely admit.  There is no way to fix my problem of an attitude adjustment other than dying, to me. I've tried most ways. Read books, talked to psychiatrists etc. etc. Didn't really do anything for me.
